title: Josiah Reigns and the Book of the Law Found

questions.question: How old was Josiah when he began to reign?
questions.explanation: 2 Kings 22:1 (ESV): "Josiah was eight years old when he began to reign..."

questions.question: How long did Josiah reign?
questions.explanation: 2 Kings 22:1 (ESV): "...and he reigned thirty-one years in Jerusalem."

questions.question: Who found the Book of the Law in the house of the Lord?
questions.explanation: 2 Kings 22:8 (ESV): "And Hilkiah the high priest said to Shaphan the secretary, 'I have found the Book of the Law...'"

questions.question: What did Josiah do when he heard the words of the Book of the Law?
questions.explanation: 2 Kings 22:11 (ESV): "When the king heard the words of the Book of the Law, he tore his clothes."

questions.question: Who did Josiah send to inquire of the Lord?
options: Hilkiah, Ahikam, Achbor, Shaphan, and Asaiah
questions.correctAnswer: Hilkiah, Ahikam, Achbor, Shaphan, and Asaiah
questions.explanation: 2 Kings 22:12 (ESV): "and the king commanded Hilkiah the priest, and Ahikam... and Achbor... and Shaphan... and Asaiah..."

questions.question: Who was the prophetess they consulted?
questions.explanation: 2 Kings 22:14 (ESV): "So Hilkiah... went to Huldah the prophetess..."

questions.question: What message did Huldah give regarding Jerusalem?
options: I will bring disaster upon this place and upon its inhabitants
questions.correctAnswer: I will bring disaster upon this place and upon its inhabitants
questions.explanation: 2 Kings 22:16 (ESV): "...Behold, I will bring disaster upon this place and upon its inhabitants..."

questions.question: What message did Huldah give regarding Josiah?
options: Because your heart was penitent... you shall be gathered to your grave in peace
questions.correctAnswer: Because your heart was penitent... you shall be gathered to your grave in peace
questions.explanation: 2 Kings 22:19-20 (ESV): "because your heart was penitent... therefore, behold, I will gather you to your fathers, and you shall be gathered to your grave in peace..."

questions.question: Where did the money for temple repairs come from?
options: The doorkeepers had collected it from the people
questions.correctAnswer: The doorkeepers had collected it from the people
questions.explanation: 2 Kings 22:4 (ESV): "...the money... which the keepers of the threshold have collected from the people."

questions.question: Who read the book to the king?
questions.explanation: 2 Kings 22:10 (ESV): "Then Shaphan the secretary told the king... And Shaphan read it before the king."

questions.question: In which year of Josiah's reign was the book found?
questions.explanation: 2 Kings 22:3 (ESV): "In the eighteenth year of King Josiah..."

questions.question: Where did Huldah live?
options: In Jerusalem in the Second Quarter
questions.correctAnswer: In Jerusalem in the Second Quarter
questions.explanation: 2 Kings 22:14 (ESV): "...(now she lived in Jerusalem in the Second Quarter)..."

questions.question: Who was Huldah's husband?
questions.explanation: 2 Kings 22:14 (ESV): "...the wife of Shallum the son of Tikvah..."

questions.question: Did they ask the workers for an accounting of the money?
questions.explanation: 2 Kings 22:7 (ESV): "However, no accounting shall be asked... for they deal honestly."

key_verse_text: because your heart was penitent, and you humbled yourself before the LORD... and you have torn your clothes and wept before me, I also have heard you, declares the LORD. (ESV)
